items.text: Hey Adventurers, we are finally ready to bring you the Completion Update!
Our goal with this update is to tie up some loose ends the Foundation Update left behind.

Let’s start with the stew for the crew. The stew was always intended to provide you with an opportunity to spend your extra ingredients and earn unique and valuable rewards for doing so. Due to the lack of communication regarding those rewards and the stringent linear progression of them, it never felt worth doing. The changes we made to the stew and its UI are meant to help with these problems: You can now view almost all available rewards and choose which ones you want to unlock depending on your progress!

Feedback we got a lot is that you want to have your very own shack to decorate. We added many new stew rewards and some of them allow you to gain access to the area east of the camp, where you can build and expand your own shack with up to three rooms!
Your crew got some new moves! They will now wave at you if they’ve got something for you, and perform unique animations when idle. We hope this makes them and the camp feel more alive!

Decorations got a whole lot more versatile: Every piece of furniture from each set (including the ones from newly added sets) now comes with 2 color variants in addition to its original. This gives you even more visual customization options for each shack!
Finally, the Parrot and Ancestor also get their own relationships, each with their own perks, decoration sets and even two new outfits!
Check out the patch notes for more features and changes. Of course there are many bug fixes in this update as well, please let us know if we missed any!
We hope you’ll have fun with this update and its features. Happy adventuring!
Stew for the crew overhaul!
Crew member ingredient preferences are now tracked and visible in the inventory when preparing a stew.
Up to 9 ingredients can now be added per crew member to further increase the crew happiness and stew duration.
The stew duration now increases by 1 hour per ingredient and has a limit of 24 hours.
Your crew's happiness is no longer limited by main quest progression.
When leveling up the crew happiness, you now earn a reward tokens.
Unlocked stew rewards can now be freely purchased with reward tokens instead of being unlocked linearly.
Added a new stew reward screen to view and purchase stew rewards, accessible via the regular stew menu.

Dev-Notes: There was an issue with some stew rewards not being properly unlocked with the old linear stew reward system. This caused some of you to not get specific unique items which were required for completing certain achievements like the "Collector" achievement. With the new stew reward system you can choose from every available reward in the game, allowing you to retroactively unlock any you missed out on and complete all achievements.
Added new unique stew rewards.
Added repeatable stew rewards to allow the player to trade reward tokens for components, fish, key shards and more.
Added a separate option for collecting your stew reward when talking to a crew member.

Dev-Notes: Rewards were previously collected by just talking to a crew member. Due to some quest dialogues having a higher priority, the reward dialogues were sometimes not used and the reward was not collected which caused confusion and frustration among players.
New Personal Shack!

New unique stew rewards allow you to expand your campsite to the previously uncharted plateau east of the camp. Spend reward tokens to unlock new foundations and build your very own personal shack with up to 3 rooms to decorate!
New Relationships!
You can now build your relationship with the Parrot and the Ancestor!
Improve your relationship with the Parrot by investing ingredients into the stew for the crew and raising your crew's happiness level!
Unlock the Parrot as a merchant you can encounter on four of the five islands to trade food for rare and useful items!
Gift your excess seeds from farming or exploration to the Parrot in exchange for various other items!
Improve your relationship with the Ancestor by completing the Ancestor's Trials on each available difficulty level and earn powerful perks!
Gain powerful buffs that will give you an edge in combat while wearing the golden hats rewarded for completing the Ancestor's Trials.
Convert your canoe into a mobile one-way portal stone! - Get the option to activate combat curses that will greatly increase the level of challenge during the Ancestor's trials!
New Decoration Sets!
The Parrot and Ancestor also each provide you with a new set of decorations! Find out which gifts the Parrot and Ancestor love to unlock the new Freebooter and Archaic styles
New Furniture Variants!
Customize your shacks even further with 2 new color variants for every furniture piece including the new Freebooter and Archaic decoration sets!
New Outfits!
Acquire the new pirate and adventurer outfits by completing new unique collectible challenges!
Collect each of the five Fleeting Essences hidden on each island without returning to the camp to unlock the new adventurers outfit!
Complete the Ancestor's Trial with all of the newly added combat curses enabled to unlock the new pirate's outfit!
New Idle Animations for the Crew!
We added a total of more than 20 new idle animations for most crew members to make your camp feel more alive!
With the changes to the stew screen, many UI other screens have also received various improvements!
The process of gifting items was streamlined to make giving multiple gifts less clunky, especially with a controller!
When using the telescope to travel between blink runes, those close to you will now be indicated similar to the map marker!
Various smaller changes to the map and map markers have been made to make displayed information more clear and consistent.
The Handbook has been updated to reflect the new features and changes.
Changed the spawn position of a treasure chest on the western island to make it more easily reachable.
Crew members that have a stew reward are now highlighted on the map and wave at the player.
Removed controller cursor in world map overview.
Depleted fishing zone map markers are now marked with a check on the map instead of being removed.

items.text: Hey Adventurers, we are finally ready to bring you the Foundation Update!

Our goal with this update is to improve Stranded Sails in a big way by giving you a lot of the features and content you have been waiting for since release. Due to all of your feedback we were able to identify and address a lot of areas that needed improvement. Thank you all for your support, we hope that you enjoy all the new features and changes to the game!
New Decoration System!
You can now enter and decorate your crew member’s shacks!
Collect more than 60 unique decorations from 8 different styles!
New Relationship System!
Improve your relationship with each crew member by earning relationship points for decorating their shack!
Reach relationship milestones to benefit from up to 24 unique and powerful perks from your crew!
Discover each crew member’s style preferences to make each shack as cozy as possible and unlock an alternative ending to your quest!
New Item Type: Gifts!
Discover 12 new and different gifts while adventuring!
Give your crew members gifts they love to unlock new decorations and complete your collection!
New Crew Reactions!
Your crew will react to your gifts and decorations with a total of 30 new and unique animations for each character!
New Activities On The Cursed Islands!
Explore the islands to find 6 new rewarding activities like “Monkey Chase” or “Watchful Seagulls”!
Complete these island activities to acquire shiny plunder, the essential component for creating decorations!
New Collectibles and Outfits!
Explore the Cursed Islands to find new hidden collectibles!
Complete a collectible set to unlock one of 3 new wearable outfits!
Underwater areas have become more detailed!
New vegetation has been added to underwater areas around all islands!

The handbook is now accessible in-game rather than from the pause menu. With this change as well as the addition of relationships and decorations, the inventory has been consolidated into a single element and is now part of the new “multi-menu”.
Dev-Notes: For controller, these changes resulted in the removal of the predefined tool shortcuts on the d-pad.
The map now has a specific shortcut! Use it to quickly open and close it without having to navigate through the equipment selection.
You can now mark any combination of tools, seeds and food items as favorite while viewing the equipment selection to quickly equip them in-game.
In many UI screens, most input hints are now displayed at the appropriate elements.
Added interaction indicator for seeds and updated interaction indicator while using the boat.
Added new handbook entries detailing new features as well as some existing ones.
Changed tooltips to be displayed by default to make important information in the recipe library and decoration collection more visible.
Added tooltips to the food selection.
Changed the intro to be skippable without having completed the game first. Added a note to inform you about what you are missing out on.
Added a “feedback” button to the main and pause menu. Use it to report issues or give us feedback on the game!
Input used to open newly unlocked handbook and relationship entries changed to “hold” instead of “press”.
Added and updated “NEW” indicators in multi-menu UI screens including handbook and inventory.
Adjusted map marker visuals and behaviour for various objects.
The save slot that was last saved is now clearly marked.
Updated and fixed various quest objective texts.
Various minor UI changes.: Dev-Notes: All of these changes to UI and inputs unfortunately mean that you will have to redefine your custom key bindings.
The so-called “world reset” (which causes non-unique containers, trees and fishing spots to respawn) now also happens when starting a stew for the crew.

Dev-Notes: The world reset was previously only happening when going to sleep which becomes a lot less necessary after unlocking the stew. Not sleeping caused resource containers to never respawn, resulting in material economy issues, sometimes preventing you from being able to craft items relevant for progression.
Your boat no longer moves to the camp when fast travelling (except while you are sitting inside of it). You can now recall it at any time by using the newly added jetty in the north of the camp!
Increased clickable area of interaction indicator to alleviate problems related to a targeted interactable not aligning properly with the cursor.
Rebalanced fishing spots to make each tier progressively harder and increased the pull force provided by the upgraded fishing rod to make it more impactful.
You can now manually cancel a fishing encounter instead of having to wait for the fish to escape.
Rebalanced container spawns on central island to make finding components required for Fiola’s and Sven’s shacks more reliable.
Changed component crate visuals to make them distinguishable from non-interactable crates used as environment props.
Reduced corn growth speed, ingredient and seed drop rate when harvested. Corn seeds can now be found in chests on the central island.
Dev-Notes: Although it is intended to be a readily available ingredient, corn felt too abundant and meaningless in the early stages of the game.
Changed thorn bushes on islands other than the central island to regrow whenever a world reset happens. Changed visuals of non-regrowing thorn bushes and trees to look different than regrowing ones.
Improved telescope controls when using controller.
Changes to various wave zones to prevent waves clipping through world geometry in certain areas.
Adjusted wind intensity and ambient audio volume on north-east island.
Various sound effects have been added and adjusted.
Fixed a bug that could cause the player to get stuck when hopping on a ship rigging, rope or ladder.
Fixed a bug that would enable the player to interact with the canoe while in the rowboat and vice versa, causing them to get stuck when interacting.
Fixed a bug that would lead to enemies falling through the floor during combat encounters.
Fixed a bug that would not let the player close the inventory while in a boat and using a controller.
Fixed a bug that could cause new button bindings to not work properly.
Fixed a bug that would cause the map or telescope to be used after interacting with a portal stone.
Fixed a bug that would cause NPCs to sometimes be in their shacks at night even when needed for a quest.

Dev-Notes: Your crew members should enter their shacks to sleep at night, except when talking to them is your current quest objective. They will now sometimes be inside during the day as well, but now you can visit and talk to them!
Fixed a bug that could cause enemies to stay stuck in their dying animation, preventing them from properly vanishing and letting the player progress further.
Fixed a bug that could cause ingredients in the stew menu wheel to get lost when closing the menu and quitting the game or loading another save file before another autosave happened.
Fixed a bug that would cause quest events to not properly trigger when starting a new game with the “Skip Intro” option enabled.
Fixed a bug that would prevent the player from eating food during combat.
Fixed a bug that would enable the player to open the map via shortcut while the equipment menu was open.
Fixed a bug that would cause the camera to get stuck when leaving the telescope view while placing a map marker.
Fixed a bug that would enable the player to switch tools after opening and closing the map while on a rope or ladder.
Fixed a bug that would enable the player to open the pause menu and the portal stone map at the same time.
Fixed a bug that would cause an inventory slot to be selected even when there were no items available in the current category.
Fixed a bug that would display the recipe discovery icons outside of the cooking menu.
Fixed a bug that would cause the telescope map marker to stay visible when teleporting back to camp while being in a boat.
Fixed a bug that would cause the “Continue” button to still be displayed in the main menu even after the last save file was deleted.
Fixed various bugs with camera movement and the interaction indicator when instant dialogues where triggered immediately after another dialogue.
Fixed a bug that caused the player to “surf” across the ground instead of walk after using the axe.
Fixed an issue that made it possible to trigger Fritz’s instant dialogue while sitting in the boat when finding him on the lonely sandbars.
Updated and fixed various quest positions for player and NPCs .
Removed an inaccessible portal stone placeholder near the camp.
Dev-Notes: If you have already discovered this one in your save game, its map marker will not disappear as a result of this change.
Fixed several localization issues.
Fixed various collision issues on all islands.

notes.title: A friend in need is a friend ideed!

items.text: Relationships are a new gameplay feature in Stranded Sails - Explorers of the Cursed Islands. You can improve your relationship with the crew members by helping them to settle on the Cursed Islands and decorate their houses with decoration and furniture of their favourite styles!

It’s crucial to find out what kind of gifts everyone likes to unlock new decoration pieces and which decoration style they’d love to have in their houses to successfully improve the relationship with your crew members!

notes.title: Show them you care for them - and they will care for you, too!

items.text: There are four different relationship milestones you can reach with each of your crew members, from “Thankful” to “Happy”. And every unlocked milestone will also grant you new perks and bonuses that will help you a lot while exploring, farming and gathering!
And as different the needs of your crew members are, as different are the bonuses they grant, too! So, it definitely pays off to improve your relationship with everyone. :)
And maybe… when you took care of every crew member, something special could happen!

notes.title: Let’s take a look at our dear friend and farmer: Fiola!

items.text: Along with the new relationship feature comes a new user interface that shows you details about your relationship with a crew member, the milestones you have reached, their favourite items you already discovered and more!

For example, here you can see the different milestones you can unlock with Fiola plus every bonus they grant. We already unlocked the Milestone “Thankful” and the perk “Energizing Stew”! You can also see what kind of perks await you at the higher milestones and these perks are unique to Fiola. Fritz, Cecille and the other crew members will help you all in their own ways once you improve your relationship with them!

The new UI will also keep track of the favourite items you gifted them, their favourite styles for their home decoration and the decoration styles you unlocked. Best friends know each other and the UI will help you with that!

notes.title: Take your friendship to the next level!

items.text: With the new relationship gameplay we have added a whole new layer to Stranded Sails - Explorers of the Cursed Islands and we hope you’re as excited about it as we are. Improving your friendship with the members of your crew will unlock all-new perks that will help you considerably on your journey, and every little helps! items.text: “Hey all, I hope you’re doing well.
I still have to adapt to Home Office work, especially since I’m used to working in the office together with my colleagues everyday. But I will get used to the new situation!

I currently work at home from my kitchen with a great view of my garden. Two squirrels call my garden their home at the moment and it’s fun to see them running around! I call them Chip and Chap (Chip’n Dale for those of you who get it!).

Hey everyone!

The day has finally come and we officially release our "Exploration Update", the first big update with a ton of improvements for Stranded Sails! Once again, we can’t thank you all enough for all the feedback that you send our way and the bugs that we were able to squash because you’ve found them.
We’ve made a lot of changes to the game and you can read up the juicy details in the patch notes but we want to highlight some changes here:

While exploring the Cursed Islands you will now encounter ancient portal stones. Find and activate them to be able to use key shards and crafted portal keys to travel between all of the ones you have discovered!

notes.title: Adjusted walking and rowing energy cost!

items.text: The most important feedback we got from you was that moving around the islands always costing energy made exploration feel tedious and unfun. To address this, we changed walking and rowing to no longer cost energy when moving slowly. Sprinting and your new ability to row faster will still cost energy, giving you the option to invest some of your provisions to get around quicker!
While on the high seas you will now encounter seagulls chasing flotsam. Use your new ability to row faster to race them and reach the floating treasure first to collect various items!

notes.title: Craft and cook multiple items at once

items.text: To save time, you can now craft and cook multiples of the same item. Increase the amount of resulting items while a blueprint or recipe is selected and create them all at once!

notes.title: Improved precision of interaction while using mouse & keyboard

items.text: This change should be especially noticeable while farming.

The quest line up until you get your rowboat has been streamlined to not only give you more explorative freedom early on, but also allow you to explore the Cursed Island more quickly after setting sail!
Adjusted various energy costs
Walking and rowing are now free, sprinting and rowing faster costs energy.
Adjusted energy costs of tool usage to compensate for the now free movement.
Rebalanced fishing energy costs for fish within each tier to be more similar in overall energy required to catch it.
Improved ingame explanation and communication for the recipe discovery system.
Items dropped are now picked up more reliably and from further away, resulting in you not having to walk over each dropped item to collect it.
Selecting your map via its shortcut will now instantly open the map UI instead of equipping it.
Potatoes, onions and carrots will now be dug out automatically after harvesting them.
Added day, daytime, buff duration and description display. Open your tool selection to view these details.
You can now hold down the interact button to cut down trees and bushes.
You are now able to skip the stew for the crew UI animation after starting one.
Changed most containers in the world to be opened with a specific tool, adjusted their visuals, contents, spawn and drop rates.
Seeds are now gathered a lot less frequently while farming, and can instead be found more frequently while exploring.
Added thorn bushes to various locations in the world, requiring you to cut them down with your axe to progress.
Adjusted optional camp structure costs.
Changed the interaction priority of equipped food, making it less likely to accidentally eat it while trying to interact with something else.
Stew rewards can now be acquired more reliably from quest relevant NPCs.
Reduced time it takes for fish to bite and increased amount of fish that can be caught in each fishing spot.
Added a more informative interaction indicator. It now displays an icon corresponding to the tool(s) you need to equip to interact with certain objects.
Adjusted the way the camera follows the player character, fixing an issue that could cause “jittery” camera movement.
Increased all dialogue text scroll speeds and added an “instant” option.
Improved formatting of russian localization and fixed various typos in german translation.
The complete list with all bugfixes can be found in our last announcement.

releases.displayName: NEW UPDATE - Planned for this year!

items.text: Hello adventurers,

We would like to thank all those who have written us their feedback so far and shared their honest opinions with us. We take your constructive feedback very seriously and take a close look at every review and feedback submission because we want to change and improve the game together with you. We are happy that many of you recognize the potential of Stranded Sails and we would like to harness it with your support.

First bug fixes and adjustments have already been made. We have planned some changes and improvements to come in the future and our goal is to provide you with a new update estimated by the end of this year.
The following lists some of the changes we plan on making to improve gameplay, add content and give the game more variety and depth in general.
(1) Planned Quality of life improvements including but not limited to the following:
• Reduce time it takes to craft or cook multiples of the same item
• Add auto pickup of items within a larger radius
• Make tree-chopping more comfortable by allowing you to hold down the interact button
• Add display of buff durations for you to see how long a buff will last
• Add display of the selected recipe’s/blueprint’s tooltip while cooking/crafting
• Make eating food not interfere with NPC/object interaction
• Improve usability of the map by allowing you to access it more easily and quickly
• Improve mouse-only gameplay (especially with regards to precision of movement and interaction)
(2) Planned Energy & Exploration Update with the goal of making exploration more interesting and energy consumption feel rewarding rather than punishing:
• Improving rowing gameplay
• Add necessity of using various tools while exploring
• Add fast travel option between all different islands
• Make the stew for the crew relevant in the late game
• Shorten the intro and tutorial so that you get to explore the Cursed Islands earlier after starting the game
• Improve Recipe Discovery mechanics tutorialization
• New achievements & Steam leaderboards
(3) Planned Combat & Survival Update with the goal of improving combat variety, depth and overall challenge:
• Make enemies more interesting and varied
• Make combat gameplay more interesting by allowing you to dodge during combat
• Adjust the Ancestor’s Trial to be a challenge rather than a chore
• Add a way for you to play a more challenging version of the game
• New achievements & Steam leaderboards
Please keep in mind that all of the changes listed are still subject to change, depending on how well those ideas work out in the end, but also depending on your feedback going forward.

As mentioned above, we try to bring changes and improvements to Stranded Sails as soon as we can. More updates will follow at the beginning of next year. We want the world of the Cursed Islands to feel more and more alive and make exploring it meaningful by adding side activities in the open world. We also want to add optional goals for you to work towards.
We hope that you will continue providing us with feedback and thank you for staying with us on this journey of making Stranded Sails a great game.
Your team at rokaplay & Lemonbomb Entertainment

Save games that got corrupted due to the glitch should now work again with this patch. Players that lost their boat should now also get it back. If you still have issues concerning this bug, don't hesitate to contact us!

Fixed a bug that could prevent the player from progressing in the "Ancestral Recall" quest by not giving them a second chance to touch a symbol after they selected "Leave" the first time they interacted with it.

Fixed an issue with the quest "The First Statue" that would enable players to get access to the canoe without walking through a necessary objective trigger.: Dev Notes: Players who were tasked with finding the canoe could simply return to the camp via map and get it without advancing in the questline. We added additional trigger zones so this is no longer possible. Players who already got the canoe but haven't advanced in the quest simply have to walk up the pyramid to be able to continue.
Fixed a bug that got players stuck in the ship's cabin during the quest "Turn of Events".

Fixed a bug that would prevent the barriers from going down after finishing a combat encounter.: Dev Notes: This only happened if a player fainted in combat and retried the same encounter after. The barriers would not go down due to the combat zone not properly resetting.
Fixed a bug that would cause the questlog to stay hidden after fainting during combat.
Fixed an issue that could cause the player to get stuck in the cooking/crafting menu when trying to leave while the cooking/crafting animation was still in progress.
Fixed an issue that could cause spawned quest items to get inaccessible after reloading the game on the very first island the player got stranded on.
Fixed an issue that could cause the player movement controls to be disabled when starting the game.: Dev Notes: This was fixable by opening and closing the pause menu.
Fixed a bug that could cause a spawned quest item to be duplicated when reloading at a specific point after picking it up.

With this patch we have fixed a lot of the progression blocking bugs, most notably the Yellow Screen of Death issue. We are still working on general improvements of the game and we thank each and everyone of you for your patience.
Expect to hear more from us soon.

Is Stranded Sails a pure passion project?

Yes, it definitely is. We want to create something new and provide players with a most enjoyable gaming experience. With Lemonbomb as our developer, we have a creative and ambitious partner with whom we want to implement completely new game projects like Stranded Sails.
Is the game buy-to-play or free-to-play?
The game is absolutely buy-to-play. There are no hidden pay-to-win mechanics or microtransactions as well as lootboxes.
How close is the game to Harvest Moon and Stardew Valley?

The game sets sail for a new gaming experience fusing adventure and farming. Thus farming is only a partial aspect of the game. By combining adventure and farming elements we create a world in which your achievements in a certain area will unlock new possibilities in another one.
Will the game have potential romance / marriage options?

No, there's no romance or marriage in the game. The main focus of our survival adventure is on the story and the final goal, not on the relationships between the characters. You have to make sure that your crew is happy and well-fed so that they actively support you, for example in farming. This is important because you will always be in an active story quest.
How far can you go in doing stuff like farming?

Farming is important on the remote islands to ensure survival and satisfaction of the crew in the camp. There are different plants to cultivate and by exploring you will discover new seeds. However, the game does not focus solely on farming as we’ll send you on various adventurous explorations and quests!
Are there animals on the farm? Can I have pets to play with?
There are no livestock and no pets to play with.
How far can you go in doing stuff like building?

You are ship-wrecked on a mysterious archipelago and now it’s up to you to build a survival camp consisting of a cooking and crafting station, shacks for your crew or fields to farm crops. In the course of the game, you can expand your environment in the given context.
All I saw from the trailer is a little bit of farming and traveling by a boat. I can’t tell much from that!

The game is a mixture of farming and adventure. Our goal is to create as diverse a gameplay experience as possible, both exciting and relaxing. As a counterbalance to “relaxed” farming there are extensive adventures with exciting explorations, tricky puzzles and quests. In addition, exploration is one of the core gameplay loops that enables progression in the farming loop and vice versa. We are currently in the pre-alpha phase. So far we have only released one teaser. With the next trailer you’ll see more… So stay tuned!
Will this game have combat?

Outside the survival camp adventurous explorations and and quests await you as well as strange threats. Combat is a part of the game, it will be simple and fun. Are you ready to awaken the adventurer inside?
Is there going to be a stamina or schedule system that limits what you can do in a day?

Yes! There is a day and night rhythm with action and recovery phases. These phases must not be observed but it is encouraged by mechanics that it is done because it allows a more efficient energy balance. In addition, cooking plays a major role as your energy status will increase or decrease at different rates depending on your diet.
Are there ways to make farming more efficient?
Yes, there will be ways to make farming (e.g. watering) more efficient in the course of the game.
Is there going to be a coop mode?
The game is released without coop mode, because we want to create the most enjoyable singleplayer experience (we can provide). How about? Are you in?
